description: Buys one live paid offering from the same catalogue shown on agent cards, at its listed priceUsd in USD, paid over x402. Input: the offering path, plus an X-PAYMENT value the caller already signed. Paylyte does not hold or spend a wallet. Without a payment, it returns the same 402 challenge the paid path sends, with the USD price and maxAmountRequired. Unknown paths and paths not on that catalogue are refused. It does not write or edit Core.

path.description: Paid path of one live offering, such as /v1/data/fees/forecast. Its priceUsd is listed on that offering.

payment.description: The X-PAYMENT value already signed for this path. When it is absent, the result is the 402 challenge with the USD price and maxAmountRequired.

record_id.description: Official checked record id for one vintage. Only for /v1/data/records/checked.

name: buy_live_offering
title: Buy a live paid offering
